name: Akai Heya Satsujin
source:
Akai Heya Satsujin (Red Room Murder) is a game that takes place in a small, rural town of Japan. The story follows main protagonist Hotaru Erai as she attends her senior year at Kobayashi Academy. Senior year means she is eligible to run for student council president, a high and all mighty role at this school which thrives off social dominance. When Erai loses the spot for president to her mortal enemy Fukumoto Kana things quickly take a turn for the worse. Erai devises a plan for her revenge, a plan of cold ruthless murder.

[From [url=https://akaiheyasatsujin.itch.io/akai-heya-satsujin-pre-alpha-10]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Akai Heya Satsujin》（红屋杀人案）的故事发生在日本一座偏僻的小镇。主角Hotaru Erai正在Kobayashi学园读毕业班，这意味着她终于有资格竞选学生会长。在这所崇尚地位与支配力的学校，学生会长拥有至高无上的权力。当Erai输给死敌Fukumoto Kana，错失会长之位后，事态迅速恶化。Erai开始筹划复仇——一场冷酷无情的谋杀。

[摘自[url=https://akaiheyasatsujin.itch.io/akai-heya-satsujin-pre-alpha-10]itch.io[/url]]
